text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop bug was identified in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift that affected the mobile sync engine.","The conflict loop manifested only after the client had already retried once.","The symptom was two clients continuously rewriting each other on every sync pass.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was shared across multiple function calls.","The fix made the default argument empty and built the value per call, implemented in PR #2693 on branch fix/conflict-loop-1.","The conflict loop could be reproduced by editing the same note on two different devices while both were offline.","After applying the fix, memory usage stabilized at 503 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB."]}
